model: ADXNP soft starters with CX04 RS-485 module (Modbus RTU)
applies_to: ADXNP (advanced version) soft starters fitted with the CX04 RS-485 module, per instruction manual I651 GB 02 24.
summary: The Lovato ADXN is a compact soft starter with built-in bypass for pumps, fans, compressors and conveyors. Only the advanced ADXNP version talks Modbus RTU, through the CX04 RS-485 module clipped to its optical port. This map covers voltage, phase currents and powers, frequency, torque, thermal status, thyristor temperature, input and output status, and the start/stop command.

addressing.note: The address table prints hex addresses one above the request address; the manual's example reads thyristor temperature (table 0FB2h) by sending 0F B1, 'decreased by one'. Addresses here are already reduced by one.

source.title: ADXN soft starters - instruction manual
source.pages: pp. 14-15 (CX04 module, 12.1 Modbus address table, example, start/stop commands)

notes: Measures are read with function 03 or 04 and are listed as input registers; up to 100 consecutive registers per read. The start/stop command uses function 06.
Word order: the example answer 00 00 01 10 decodes to 272 = 27.2 °C, so 32-bit values are high word first (ABCD).
Scales are the divisors printed in the unit column (V/100, A/10000, kW/100000, Hz/1000, %/10, °C/10).

Left out: the status register F94h, because it is printed as 2 words with format 'Unsigned integer', so its width is unclear. The printed status values are 0 no power line, 1 ready, 2 start delay, 3 acceleration ramp, 4 current limit, 5 run, 6 bypass closed, 7 deceleration ramp, 8 alarm.
Parameter setting over Modbus is described only by reference to the ADXL protocol document (I454), so it is not repeated here.
Up to 31 ADXNP with CX04 can share one RS-485 line.

registers.description: Printed as bool (0/1); the document does not say which state is 1.

registers.name: Outputs status

registers.name: Output 1 (11-14) status
registers.description: Printed as bool (0/1); the document does not say which state is 1.

registers.name: Output 2 (11-24) status
registers.description: Printed as bool (0/1); the document does not say which state is 1.

registers.name: Start/stop command
registers.description: Needs P04.04 = ON and the ST input closed.

integration.summary: Fit the CX04 module, then read currents (08h-0Dh), total power (3Ah), thermal status (FB0h) and thyristor temperature (FB2h) with function 04, subtracting one from each table address. Start or stop with 1 or 0 written to 1002h.
integration.enable: Set the communication menu (M06) on the ADXNP with the LOVATO NFC app or Xpress software while the CX04 is unplugged, then clip the CX04 onto the optical port and wire RS-485 (SG, A, B) plus 24 V AC/DC to the module.
quirks: Table addresses are one above the wire address.
setup: Defaults: node 1, 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit.
For Modbus start/stop set P04.04 = ON and keep the ST input closed; opening ST stops the motor and Modbus commands are ignored.
gotchas: The manual describes Modbus only for the ADXNP (advanced) version with the CX04 module.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
